node.statement: For every B=direct-sum_{r=1}^m M_{d_r}, an explicit finite Weyl-unitary and sign-phase average produces D=sum_t q_t W_t^dagger tensor W_t with all W_t unitary, q_t>=0 and sum_t q_t=1; this D obeys ZD=DZ for every Z in B, pi(D)=I_B, and ||D||_pi=sum_t q_t||W_t^dagger||||W_t||=1 independently of m and the d_r.
